SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

/* cppi::840cf1687f9a6e942e551717cf5e8923394e3044c321539ecb3ff06a187a122c */
SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
             adjusted_date AS (
                 SELECT
                     query_date,
                     CASE
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
                         WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
                         END AS business_date
                 FROM params
             ),
             account_mapping_query AS (
                 SELECT
                     date_format(pam.as_of_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                 WHERE pam.as_of_date BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                           AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
             ),
             unioned_data AS (
                 select COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
                        COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM account_mapping_query

                 UNION

                 SELECT
                     scd.business_date AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                     '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
                     '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
                     COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
                 FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 WHERE CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) BETWEEN (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '7' day
                     AND (SELECT business_date FROM adjusted_date) - interval '1' day
                   and NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM account_mapping_query fq
                     WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
                       AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
                 )
             ),
             daily_counts AS (
                 SELECT business_date, COUNT(*) AS record_count
                 FROM unioned_data
                 GROUP BY business_date
             ),
             average_count AS (
                 SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
                 FROM daily_counts
             )
        SELECT cast(avg_count as varchar) FROM average_count) T LIMIT 0

/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc,
            net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc AS gross_purchase_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    )

        SELECT trans.*,

                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'

                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,

            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans

    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,

               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans
            INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
                ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
            INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp mp
                ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
            LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
               ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
              AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
            WHERE trans.rn = 1
            AND fin.rn = 1     
    ),
    aggregated_trans AS (
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Gross Dividend' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS gross_div_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Dividend Taxes' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS div_taxes_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_cos_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Sell GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS sell_gl_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Net Purchase' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS net_purchase_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_qc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_qc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_qc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
        gross_div_pc,gross_div_qc,div_taxes_pc,div_taxes_qc,
        net_purchase_qc,purchase_cost_qc,net_purchase_pc,purchase_cost_pc,
        sell_roc_pc, sell_cos_pc,sell_gl_pc,sell_roc_qc, sell_cos_qc,sell_gl_qc,

            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc AS net_sell_qc,
            cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS total_cap_qc,
            sell_roc_qc + sell_cos_qc + sell_gl_qc + net_purchase_qc + purchase_cost_qc + cap_roc_qc + cap_gl_qc AS net_cap_bal_qc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,

            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,

            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,

LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec

       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code

ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-26'
)
SELECT  a.*, b.*, c.*, d.*, e.*, g.*, l.*, '2025-06-26' as business_date,
(case when g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code is not null then g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code
      when l.country_of_exposure_code is not null then l.country_of_exposure_code
      when a.exposure_country_code is not null then a.exposure_country_code
      else null end) as moodys_exposure_country_code
from
  (
	select 
	   ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
	   ss.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
	   ss.security_group_name,
	   ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
	   s.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_department_name,
	   ref.id_cppib_party as id_counterparty,
	   ss.abor_security_name as security_name,
	   ss.abor_security_number as security_no,
	   ss.cppib_sec_id as cppib_sec_id,
	   null as id_enterprise_holding,
	   ref.party_name as issuer_name,
	   sec.abor_country_id as country_code,
	   sec.country_of_exposure_code as exposure_country_code,
	   sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
	   sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
	   sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
	   ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
	   ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
	   ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
	   ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,
	   cast(ss.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
	   ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
	   ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc,
	   ss.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,
	   ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as current_nominal,
	   ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as current_nominal_pc,
	   '48' as instrument_type_code,
	   ss.abor_instrument_type as instrument_type_name,
	   ss.quotation_currency_code as currency,
	   ss.security_group_id as security_group_code,
	   0.0 as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
	   0.0 as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
	   ss.quotation_currency_code as current_notional_currency,
	   ss.quotation_currency_code as market_value_currency,
	   ss.abor_security_type_id as security_type_code
	from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
	left join RankedSecurities sec 
		on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
	left join reference.scd_party_issuer ref
	    on sec.abor_issuer_id = ref.party_id
	    and ss.business_date = ref.business_date
	left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten  s
		on ss.model_portfolio_id = s.model_portfolio
		and ss.business_date = s.business_date
	where ss.business_date = '2025-06-26'
	and s.InvestmentStructureLevel3 <> 'EPM'
	and InvestmentStructure = (select max(distinct InvestmentStructure) 
                                   from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten 
                                   where business_date = '2025-06-26'
                                   and InvestmentStructure like 'CPPIB_F%')
	and sec.rn = 1) as a
	
left join

   (select
      currency_code,
      currency_name
      from reference.reference_currency_codes
      where business_date = date'2025-06-26'

      from asset.asset_security_identifiers
      where business_date = date'2025-06-26'

left join

(case when g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code is not null then g.cppib_country_of_exposure_code
      when l.country_of_exposure_code is not null then l.country_of_exposure_code
      when a.exposure_country_code is not null then a.exposure_country_code
      else null end) as moodys_exposure_country_code
from
  (
	select 
	   ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
	   ss.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
	   ss.security_group_name,

	   sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,

-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,

WITH
eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Infrastructure'                 AS inv_strategy, 'Infrastructure'                 AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
),

has_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT security_identifier, 'Y' as has_transactions_y_n
    FROM trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions trans
    WHERE
        CAST(trans.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
        and trans.transaction_type = 'transaction' AND trans.is_cancelled = 'False' 
        AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) < CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
        AND trans.security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
),

has_dw_transaction_list as (
    SELECT DISTINCT business_date, security_identifier, 'Y' as has_dw_transactions_y_n
    FROM reference_uat.ci_sentry_capital_ledger_projections 
    WHERE 
        CAST(business_date as DATE) = CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
        AND CAST(expected_trade_date AS DATE) > CAST('2025-06-26' AS DATE)
)

SELECT
    'Sentry Reference'                           AS source
   , '2025-06-26'                           AS business_date
   , '902b8709-5b14-4db7-9785-2c415d8b1b99'                                  AS run_id
   , '2025-06-27 15:03:35'                       AS extract_timestamp
   , '2025-06-27T15:03:35.782676-04:00'              AS extract_timestamp_iso_8601
   , 'America/Toronto'             AS extract_timestamp_time_zone
   , NULL                                        AS account_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS scd_id
   , SEC.security_identifier                     AS security_identifier
   , SEC.issuer_identifier                       AS issuer_identifier
   , SEC.cppib_security_id                       AS cppib_security_id
   , ISSUER.cppib_entity_id                      AS sentry_issuer_id
   , NULL                                        AS source_data_id
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS sentry_security_id
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_code
   , SEC.scd_id                                  AS deal_id
   , SEC.dc_opportunity_id                       AS upstream_pipeline_number
   , SEC.security_name                           AS security_name
   , SEC.id_signal                               AS strategy
   , SEC.inv_group                               AS sub_strategy
   , SEC.security_name                           AS project_name
   , SEC.security_name                           AS investment_name
   , ISSUER.country_of_exposure                  AS country_of_exposure
   , SEC.currency                                AS funding_currency
   , NULL                                        AS deal_currency
   , SEC.private_vs_public                       AS private_vs_public
   , SEC.asset_category                          AS asset_category
   , SEC.seniority                               AS seniority
   , SEC.ir_rating                               AS risk_rating
   , SEC.asset_type                              AS asset_type
   , 'Credit Investments'                        AS investment_department_id
   , 'Active'                                    AS investment_status
   , 'Capital Call & Distribution Notices'       AS investment_lifecycle
   , NULL                                        AS deployment_disposition
   , ISSUER.gics_sector                          AS sector
   , NULL                                        AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local
   , NULL                                        AS funded_amount
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_net
   , COUP.maturity_date                          AS maturity_date
   , NULL                                        AS market_value
   , NULL                                        AS portfolio_name
   , SEC.sentry_security_type                    AS sentry_security_type
   , NULL                                        AS price_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS quantity_multiplier
   , NULL                                        AS debt_factor
   , NULL                                        AS model_portfolio_id
   , NULL                                        AS ticket_number
   , 80                                          AS probability_of_close
   , 'Binding'                                   AS binding
   , 'Net Purchases and Sales'                   AS capital_usage_component
   , NULL                                        AS transaction_cash_flow_type
   , 'Y'                                         AS send_to_treasury_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS expected_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_trade_date
   , CAST(NULLIF(SEC.expected_exit_price, '')    AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS expected_exit_price
   , SEC.expected_exit_probability               AS expected_exit_probability
   , SEC.expected_exit_date                      AS expected_exit_date
   , NULL                                        AS expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm
   , NULL                                        AS unadjusted_exit_projection
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_by
   , NULL                                        AS last_updated_date
   , 'ID_CI_WRITE'                               AS created_by_user_group
   , NULL                                        AS created_by
   , NULL                                        AS date_updated
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_required
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_date
   , NULL                                        AS luxco_and_other_jurisdictions_funding_amount
   , NULL                                        AS fo_comments
   , NULL                                        AS pec_recusals
   , NULL                                        AS pec_pipeline_y_n
   , NULL                                        AS fx_spot
   , NULL                                        AS full_amt_cad_mm
   , NULL                                        AS rejected_deals_reason
   , NULL                                        AS investment_program
   , NULL                                        AS investment_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS investment_group
   , NULL                                        AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS comment
   , NULL                                        AS error
   , 'reference_uat.ci_sentry_security, reference_uat.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_uat.ci_sentry_issuer, trades_deals_uat.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions'
                                                 AS data_sources_list
   , '2025-06-26'        AS sentry_security_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-26' AS sentry_coupon_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-26'          AS sentry_issuer_src_business_date
   , '2025-06-26'  AS sentry_cashflows_all_transactions_business_date
   , '2025-06-26' AS sentry_dw_transactions_business_date
   , TRY_CAST(NULLIF(SEC.dc_opportunity_id,'') as BIGINT)    AS dc_opportunity_id     --BIGINT
   , coalesce(HAS_TRANS.has_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_transactions_y_n
   , coalesce(HAS_DW_TRANS.has_dw_transactions_y_n, 'N') as has_dw_transactions_y_n

FROM eligible_securities        AS SEC
LEFT JOIN issuer_list           AS ISSUER            ON SEC.issuer_identifier     = ISSUER.issuer_identifier
LEFT JOIN inv_group_mapping     AS INV_GROUP_MAP     ON SEC.inv_group             = INV_GROUP_MAP.inv_group
LEFT JOIN inv_strategy_mapping  AS INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP ON SEC.inv_strategy          = INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP.inv_strategy
LEFT JOIN has_transaction_list  AS HAS_TRANS         ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_TRANS.security_identifier
LEFT JOIN has_dw_transaction_list  AS HAS_DW_TRANS   ON SEC.security_identifier   = HAS_DW_TRANS.security_identifier
LEFT JOIN coupon_list           AS COUP              ON SEC.security_identifier   = COUP.security_identifier

  "Custom_SQL_Query"."position_key" AS "position_key",
  "Custom_SQL_Query"."source_business_date" AS "source_business_date"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
      to_date(business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as source_business_date,
      investment_dept,
      investment_strat,
      scd_model_portfolio as model_portfolio,
      position_key,

      issuer_rating,
      CASE
          WHEN issuer_rating = 'AAA' THEN 1

          WHEN issuer_rating = 'CCC+' THEN 17
          WHEN issuer_rating = 'CCC' THEN 18
          WHEN issuer_rating = 'CCC-' THEN 19
          WHEN issuer_rating = 'CC' THEN 20
          WHEN issuer_rating = 'C' THEN 21
          WHEN issuer_rating = 'D' THEN 22
          ELSE NULL
      END AS issuer_rating_numerical_value,
      inst_final_rating,
      CASE
          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'AAA' THEN 1
          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'AA+' THEN 2
          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'AA' THEN 3
          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'AA-' THEN 4

          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'BB+' THEN 11
          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'BB' THEN 12

          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'CC' THEN 20
          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'C' THEN 21
          WHEN inst_final_rating = 'D' THEN 22
          ELSE NULL
      END AS inst_final_rating_numerical_value

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 17 and 18
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 17:51:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight 601d1f93-4de5-4361-ba97-09b7a93dc746 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

/* cppi::1c2060603ef62c132ae5aaa8e3bd1c969c1d9df0b1c1f50c97364a37bbdfef1b */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 19:16:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

  from holdings.scd_holdings_main h
  join (
  SELECT *,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
			PARTITION BY abor_security_id
			ORDER BY business_date DESC
		) AS rn
	FROM reference.scd_securities

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 04:35:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 27
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-27 10:06:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight e80cf8b2-d1ba-46ae-a370-d396899212c9 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc

					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */

				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 2

	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

	select

			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'

			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	select * from scd_perf

	select * from perf

	select

			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (

			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc

				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all

				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

				, pnl_4yp_lc

			and scd.split_level = perf."level"

					and scd.split_level = 1

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2

	cross join unnest (

		array[

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */

				(

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

					and scd.split_level = 0

				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1

	cross join unnest (

		array[

			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
